58 capitula, h1..h58, exactly as CURRICULUM §2 lists them.

*** NO NAME OF OUR LORD AND NO WORD OF THE PASSION IS IN THIS KEY. ***
`crux` and `crucifīgit` are not vocabulary cards anywhere in the liber
(see the ruling in content/_ledger-historia-l9.md), so js/app.js
bossWords() cannot resolve them and they can appear in no quiz row, no
sententia gap and no distractor. h57 is represented in the boss only by
its supper and h58 only by the OPEN tomb.
l9 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
NAME FORMS IN THE KEY: `praesēpe`, `tūs`, `Ioannēs`, `nāvis`,
`sepulcrum`. Only `Ioannēs` is a proper name, and its single macron is
on the nominative ending (Greek -ης → long -ēs, the `Tobiās` reasoning of
Liber VIII). `Iesus`, `Maria` and `Ioseph` are BARE everywhere in the
liber per LATIN-STYLE §1, and none of them is in this key, so the
spelling question touches nothing here.
